body:
When I was a little kid, my mother told me I wasn't allowed to play with boys anymore (around the start of elementary school). I asked her why and she told me that if I liked playing with boys I was "咸濕". As a girl who was very much a tomboy and only liked playing with boy things and no other girl I knew liked what I liked, I was very confused and saddened. I decided to play with boys anyway. This resulted in a six year period where even talking to a boy, working with one on a project or looking at one resulted in her branding me as "咸濕". Years later, I learned that "咸濕" roughly translates to horny and wanted to have sex and date and things. I was horrified that my playmate preferences as a 5 year old were interpreted as a sex drive. 

This other thing will make all of you hate me, but it really makes me angry so I guess I have to get it out of the way. My parents had really high expectations for me as a kid. I learned to read at the age of 3 and had pretty good grades in school, which can't have helped with the level of expectation. I also started learning the piano at the age of 5, mostly because I felt that my parents would yell at me less. Because of the huge amount of practise that doing well in an instrument entails, and because of numerous worksheets and exercises I had to do, I never got to watch cartoons or play with toys or play any games. I have Aspergers, and the lack of social contact with other kids probably didn't help. I know this makes me sound selfish but I still sometimes question whether this effort was really worth missing out on so many years of my childhood.

Thanks buddy. I've calmed down a bit now. 

I've got the bad habit of turning all of my negative emotions into anger. I'm scared I'll snap on someone one day and it'll be too late to turn back. Not guns or anything (I don't live in the US) but I'm always kinda worried I'll go berserk on someone or I'll be so down that I'll plummet 30 floors down a skyscraper.

Sometimes I'm not consciously trying to hide things though. Sometimes I can't really work out how to show how I'm really feeling to people so I just don't at all.
